en: Multiview postcard labeled "ARGEȘ" showing a large curved concrete dam and reservoir in a mountainous landscape (Vidraru Lake), an inset of a forest campsite with tents and a car, and an inset of an ornate building resembling the Curtea de Argeș railway station. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a Romanian 40 bani stamp, and postmarks including "JUD. ARGEȘ" and an arrival cancel for București dated 01.VII.72.
